description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontHot TubHigh Pointe Resort - GULF VIEWS and Pool view - Top Floor!The Space Luxury Beachfront Escape | High Pointe Resort Condo QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Exclusive Access to High Pointe Amenities – Experience resort-style luxury 6,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool w/ Waterfalls – Relax & unwind Private Beach Access – Just steps from sugar-white sands Tennis & Pickleball Courts – Stay active in paradise Access to Crabby Steve’s Beachfront Restaurant – Dine with a view Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected during your stay One FREE Beach Chair Set – Available March 1st – October 1st Six Amenity Bands Included – Enjoy full resort perks General Parking with Passes Provided Professionally Managed, 24/7 ServiceWelcome to High Pointe 434Beautiful Top Floor Condo in High Pointe Resort!OUR LOCATIONSet on Seacrest Beach, you’ll enjoy access to the fantastic pool, which features waterfalls, a spa and a wading pool. Private beach access is a mere 100 yards away along a boardwalk, and the High Pointe Resort also offers tennis and a children’s playground.There’s plenty of places to eat within a few minutes’ walk, from casual dining at Crabby Steve’s on the beach to upscale-cantina Mexican fare at La Cocina.A 10-minute walk takes you to Sea Contemporary Art Space for some culture before wandering back to the miles and miles of golden Florida beach.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** Golf Carts are not allowed in this community.**** Please note that guests are not allowed visitors in this community**** Please note there will be construction at the property and the balcony will be unavailable until Memorial Day 2025**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom - King sized bed, private en suite bath with large walk-in showerGuest Bedroom - Two sets of bunk beds with twins on top and full beds on bottom, shared bathroom with tub/shower comboAREA ATTRACTIONS:High Pointe Resort is a 5 min stroll (2 blocks) from Rosemary Beach's village, restaurants and shops. The 30A Bike path runs right through the front of the property and meanders along the entire 18 miles of Scenic 30A.Show less
